description: Trejhara Solutions Limited provides information technology services in the Asia Pacific and internationally. It offers SCMProfit, a logistic solution that allows to streamline and enhance logistics operations in various segments, such as B2B warehousing, freight forwarding, project logistics, returnable supply chain, transportation and distribution, e-commerce and fulfillment, vaccine supply chain, and manufacturing. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.
